_comment: Scoring + routing thresholds. Founder tunes these. score is 0-100.
_nurture_comment: Outreach playbook nurture caps (OUTREACH_PLAYBOOKS.md §6 rule 4). After the cap, the run PARKS.
_verify_comment: Email-verify step (STEP 1.5). verify_ttl_days = never re-verify the same email within this window. allow_catch_all_default = whether a catch_all/risky email passes the READY gate (per-ICP override via clients.icp_config.allow_catch_all). verify.provider_order = SMTP-verifier vendors tried in order, skipping exhausted ones. min_corroborations/small_company_max = Gate A (corroboration) thresholds. always_smtp (per-ICP) forces Gate B.
_pool_floor_comment: Scheduler pool-floor (STEP 1.5): target READY = ready_leads_per_day x ready_pool_days. Below target -> enqueue discovery+enrich to close the gap, within caps. default_ready_leads_per_day used when the ICP has none.
